wiki.title: Chris Larson
wiki.extract: Christopher J. Larson (born November 12, 1980) is an American politician who has represented Wisconsin's 7th Senate district in the Wisconsin Senate since 2011. A member of the Democratic Party, he was the Senate minority leader from 2013 through 2014, and currently serves as Senate Democratic caucus chair.
